scope: Original-source omission recovery, exact-span deduplication, audited event association dates, prefaced structured response parsing, source performer enclosures. Declared synthetic checks only.
qualification_embeddings: noop only in owned test stack; normal stack retains Gemini embeddings

phases.name: intermediate old association binary
phases.failure: stale association dates; initial isolated restart failed before changing services

phases.name: actual two-chunk stress
phases.failure: English partial performer premise withheld; French prefaced JSON parsed as plain fields/malformed actor names

evaluation_protocol_changes: Performer source quote must contain its entire independently verified node action anchor; it need not include a longer fixture recipient/modifier. Exact source bytes, source identity, actor set and distinct action remain required.
Association edge occurred_at/valid_from/date/date_inferred must agree with the audited originating event.
Final graph must contain no structured JSON field-name artifacts.
fixture_boundaries: New payment/dispute/withdrawal fixtures and long-source fixtures frozen before their first requests. Later runs deliberately repeat now-known cases. Two-chunk cases use a related synthetic task; neither opaque identifiers nor length make these independently reviewed real-contract gold. Long ~62KB cases took the chunked branch with one chunk; >80KB stress cases used two actual chunks. Long English fixture administrative annex is French; the two-chunk English annex is English.
limitations: A bounded model omission check does not certify complete extraction or legal semantics.
120 proposed audit actions, configured indexed input budget and 60-second request timeout remain; skipped/failed/partial receipts stay visible.
Overlapping anchors are withheld rather than merged semantically; disjoint equal-purpose actions and ambiguous repeated text still require review.
Normative clause coverage, event categories, amendment effectiveness, conflicts, cross-references and real contracts are not fully qualified.
Existing user contracts are not reanalyzed or migrated.
No new Laya/GLiNER training, weights, MLX or supervisor qualification in this application audit.
Some positive undated actions still have model date_role=unknown; the final declared gate does not certify occurrence-role interpretation.
